links.comparator_used: Original deployed model V1 (not retrained), versus retrained model V2 trained on 6 times more data
links.outcome: Concordance with reported labels across three evaluation sets: recent production hold-out, original pre-AI human-labeled validation set, and recent human-only or human-corrected labels
links.effect: V2 had 10% lower concordance than V1 on the recent production hold-out set (mostly AI-influenced labels). Performance was similar on the pre-AI validation set. V2 outperformed V1 on recent cases with human-only or human-corrected labels, particularly for less-common stone types.
links.tradeoff: An AI label feedback loop, in which AI-influenced labels contaminate the retraining and evaluation data, confounded retraining and evaluation. Ongoing human annotation and careful validation set construction are needed.
links.quote: V2 demonstrated a 10% lower concordance rate than V1 when evaluated on the recent production hold-out set, despite a much larger training dataset.

design_hint: ongoing human annotation and careful validation set construction for retraining
